ideas.pitch: A localized mobile health triage system featuring rPPG heart rate sensing and multi-language support (English/Tamil) designed for rural communities near coastal and semi-urban regions.
ideas.problem_statement: Real-world applicability and impact, focusing on healthcare and accessibility challenges in regional areas like Kanniyakumari.
ideas.title: CoastalCare: Tamil-Enabled Rural Triage and Outbreak Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly builds on proven health-tech hackathon patterns with localization in Tamil, making it instantly relatable and high-impact for local judges at NICHE.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered logistics and marketing copilot helping local farmers and fishermen in Tamil Nadu connect directly with regional markets, optimize delivery routes, and automate pricing.
ideas.problem_statement: Practical, innovative, and scalable solutions addressing real-world economic and agricultural supply chain challenges.
ideas.title: AgriRoute: Local Fishermen and Farmer Direct Supply Chain Copilot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses heavily on economic impact for local micro-entrepreneurs and fishermen, matching the real-world applicability criteria emphasized by the judging panel.

ideas.pitch: An agentic disaster response and evacuation platform tailored for large campus environments and coastal institutions to manage emergencies with automated routing and alerts.
ideas.problem_statement: Functional prototype development and feasibility for real-world campus and community safety scenarios.
ideas.title: CampusGuard: Real-Time IoT and Agentic Disaster Evacuation Coordinator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages agentic response workflows which won major hackathons recently, showcasing advanced technical implementation within a tight 24-hour window.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered video intelligence platform that transforms unstructured lecture and institutional video recordings into fully searchable, summarized, and accessible knowledge bases.
ideas.problem_statement: Innovation, originality, and technical understanding in processing complex unstructured institutional data.
ideas.title: VidIntel Campus: Multimodal Video Intelligence for Lecture Archives
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates a proven winning formula from data and design hackathons by tackling unstructured data transformation with a polished, working UI demo.

ideas.pitch: A community-focused application that groups nearby seniors and organizes social outings or essential travel by matching them with verified student and local volunteer drivers.
ideas.problem_statement: Real-world applicability, social impact, and user experience for underserved demographics.
ideas.title: EcoRide: Community Volunteer Driver Dispatcher for Senior Citizens
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on social good with a clear, measurable community benefit that strongly resonates with judges looking for civic impact.
